series.name: Sharp Air App hyphenated codes (main-sub)
series.notes: Official Sharp Air App table (83) plus service-manual/TRS-only extras 1-5, 6-2, 6-3, 9-1, 10-3, 17-1. Read on the remote: hold THERMOSTAT/SELECT 5s with the unit off, then step main then sub code.

title.ur: Heat exchanger thermistor short ho gaya

meaning.en: Outdoor unit heat-exchanger thermistor is reading a short circuit and the unit stops the run.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ka heat exchanger thermistor short circuit de raha hai, is liye unit chalna band kar deti hai.

causes.en: Thermistor lead wire is chafed or touching metal.
causes.ur: Thermistor ki wire ka insulation kharab ho kar metal se lag raha hai.

causes.en: Heat exchanger thermistor itself has failed inside.
causes.ur: Heat exchanger thermistor andar se kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB input stage is damaged.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB ka input hissa kharab hai.

solutions.en: Switch the breaker off for 10 seconds, then switch on and run.
solutions.ur: Breaker 10 second band karein, phir on karke chalayein.

solutions.en: Check the thermistor connector and lead wire, replace the thermistor assembly if shorted.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ka connector aur wire check karein, short ho to thermistor assembly badlein.

solutions.en: If the code returns, replace the outdoor unit control PWB.
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to outdoor unit control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Outdoor temperature thermistor short ho gaya

meaning.en: The outdoor ambient temperature sensor line is shorted, so the unit cannot trust its readings.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor ki line short hai, is liye unit reading par bharosa nahi kar sakti.

causes.en: Sensor wire damaged by rats or rubbing against the pipe.
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire chuha kaat gaya ya pipe se ragad kar kharab hui.

causes.en: Outdoor ambient thermistor has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor ambient thermistor kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle from the breaker for 10 seconds and retry.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 second power cycle karein aur dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor resistance and lead wire, replace if shorted.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ka resistance aur wire naapein, short ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the wiring is fine.
solutions.ur: Wire theek ho to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Suction thermistor short ho gaya

meaning.en: The suction line thermistor is shorted, blocking normal compressor control.
meaning.ur: Suction line ka thermistor short hai, compressor ki normal control ruk jati hai.

causes.en: Suction sensor wire is cut or shorted on the pipe.
causes.ur: Suction sensor ki wire kharab ya pipe par short ho gayi.

causes.en: Thermistor element failed.
causes.ur: Thermistor andar se kharab hai.

solutions.en: Restart once from the breaker after 10 seconds.
solutions.ur: 10 second baad breaker se ek baar restart karein.

solutions.en: Check and replace the suction thermistor if the resistance is out of range.
solutions.ur: Resistance ghalat ho to suction thermistor check karke badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: 2-way valve thermistor short ho gaya

meaning.en: The 2-way (liquid line) valve thermistor reads a short circuit.
meaning.ur: 2-way valve (liquid line) ka thermistor short circuit de raha hai.

causes.en: Expansion or 2-way valve thermistor wiring is damaged.
causes.ur: Expansion ya 2-way valve thermistor ki wire kharab hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak or valve problem can accompany this fault.
causes.ur: Is fault ke sath gas leak ya valve ka masla bhi ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting, get the system checked for gas leak.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein, system ka gas leak check karwayein.

solutions.en: Check the thermistor position and resistance, replace if shorted.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki jagah aur resistance check karein, short ho to badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Heat sink thermistor short ho gaya

meaning.en: The inverter heat-sink thermistor is shorted, so IPM overheat protection cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: Inverter heat sink ka thermistor short hai, is liye IPM overheat protection theek se kaam nahi karti.

causes.en: Heat sink sensor wiring is loose or shorted.
causes.ur: Heat sink sensor ki wire dheeli ya short hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check the sensor plug on the outdoor PWB and refit it.
solutions.ur: Outdoor PWB par sensor ka plug nikal kar theek se lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the sensor tests fine.
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi nikle to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Discharge thermistor short ho gaya

meaning.en: The compressor discharge thermistor line is shorted; this sub code appears only in the ZU1 service chart.
meaning.ur: Compressor discharge thermistor ki line short hai; yeh sub code sirf ZU1 service chart mein hai.

causes.en: Discharge sensor wire is damaged or shorted on the pipe.
causes.ur: Discharge sensor ki wire kharab ya pipe par short ho gayi.

causes.en: Thermistor element has failed.
causes.ur: Thermistor andar se kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check connector and lead wire, replace the thermistor assembly.
solutions.ur: Connector aur wire check karein, thermistor assembly badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the wiring is sound.
solutions.ur: Wire sahi ho to outdoor control PWB badlein.

notes.en: Present in the Sharp ZU1/ZHU1 service chart but not on the official Air App list (official table stops at 1-4).
notes.ur: Yeh code ZU1/ZHU1 service chart mein hai, official Air App list mein nahi (official list 1-4 par ruk jati hai).

source.title: Sharp SM-ZU1 / ZHU1 Service Manual (AY-XP12ZU1)

title.ur: Compressor ki heat bohat zyada

meaning.en: Cycle protection: compressor or high-pressure side has gone too hot, so the unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: Cycle protection: compressor ya high pressure side bohat garam ho gaya hai, unit band ho jati hai.

causes.en: Low refrigerant or a choked system.
causes.ur: Gas kam hona ya system ka rasta block hona.

causes.en: Outdoor unit air outlet is blocked or fan is weak.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ki hawa block hai ya fan kamzor chal raha hai.

causes.en: Compressor thermistor reading is wrong or expansion valve is faulty.
causes.ur: Compressor thermistor ki reading ghalat ya expansion valve kharab hai.

solutions.en: Clean the outdoor unit and make sure the outlet air path is open.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit saaf karein aur hawa ka raasta khula hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Check supply voltage at AC 230V full power.
solutions.ur: Supply voltage AC 230V par check karein.

solutions.en: Look for refrigerant leaks and charge the specified amount.
solutions.ur: Refrigerant leak check karein aur murawwat (spec) ke mutabiq charge karein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Compressor discharge heat bohat zyada

meaning.en: Discharge gas temperature has crossed the safe limit, so cycle protection stops the compressor.
meaning.ur: Discharge gas ka temperature safe limit se upar chala gaya, cycle protection ne compressor rok diya.

causes.en: Low gas charge or restricted liquid line.
causes.ur: Gas kam hai ya liquid line block hai.

causes.en: Discharge thermistor is drifted or failing.
causes.ur: Discharge thermistor ki reading shift ho rahi hai ya kharab hai.

causes.en: Condenser is dirty, heat cannot leave the unit.
causes.ur: Condenser ganda hai, heat bahar nahi nikal rahi.

solutions.en: Stop the unit and get the gas charge and leaks checked.
solutions.ur: Unit rok kar gas aur leak check karwayein.

solutions.en: Clean the condenser and check the outdoor fan rotation.
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein aur outdoor fan ki rotation check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the discharge thermistor if its resistance is off.
solutions.ur: Discharge thermistor ka resistance ghalat ho to badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger zyada garam

meaning.en: Outdoor coil temperature is too high in cooling, the unit pauses on cycle protection.
meaning.ur: Cooling mein outdoor coil ka temperature bohat zyada hai, unit cycle protection par ruk jati hai.

causes.en: Dirty condenser or blocked airflow around the outdoor unit.
causes.ur: Condenser ganda ya outdoor ke aas paas hawa ka raasta band hai.

causes.en: Short circuit or wiring issue on the coil sensor.
causes.ur: Coil sensor mein short circuit ya wiring ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle once from the breaker after 10 seconds.
solutions.ur: 10 second baad breaker se ek baar power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Wash the outdoor coil and clear anything blocking the fan.
solutions.ur: Outdoor coil dhoyein aur fan ke samne ki rukawat hataayein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Indoor heat exchanger zyada garam

meaning.en: Indoor coil temperature is too high in heating, so the unit stops on cycle protection.
meaning.ur: Heating mein indoor coil ka temperature bohat zyada hai, unit cycle protection par band ho jati hai.

causes.en: Dirty indoor filter or evaporator, airflow is low.
causes.ur: Indoor filter ya evaporator ganda hai, hawa kamzor hai.

causes.en: Indoor fan is slow or stopped.
causes.ur: Indoor fan slow chal raha hai ya band hai.

solutions.en: Clean the filter and indoor coil, then restart.
solutions.ur: Filter aur indoor coil saaf karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Check the indoor fan motor if airflow stays weak.
solutions.ur: Hawa phir bhi kamzor ho to indoor fan motor check karein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: IPM zyada garam ho gaya

meaning.en: The inverter power module (IPM) heat sink is overheating and the outdoor unit locks out.
meaning.ur: Inverter power module (IPM) ka heat sink overheat ho raha hai aur outdoor unit lock ho jati hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan not running or airflow blocked.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan nahi chal raha ya hawa block hai.

causes.en: IPM is not pressed onto the cooling fins or silicone grease is missing.
causes.ur: IPM fins par theek se nahi laga ya silicone grease nahi lagi.

causes.en: System pressure is too high or gas is overcharged.
causes.ur: System ka pressure zyada hai ya gas zyada charge hai.

solutions.en: Clear the outdoor air path and check the fan motor.
solutions.ur: Outdoor ka hawa ka raasta kholein aur fan motor check karein.

solutions.en: Refit the IPM onto the fins with even screws and fresh silicone.
solutions.ur: IPM ko fins par barabar screw aur nayi silicone ke sath lagayein.

solutions.en: Check system pressure and correct the refrigerant charge.
solutions.ur: System pressure check karke gas charge theek karein.

notes.en: Conflict: official Air App list says IPM high temperature error, while the JP TRS table reads 2-4 as 2-way valve freeze / temporary stop on the indoor unit. Confirm on your model before acting.
notes.ur: Conflict: official Air App list mein 2-4 = IPM high temperature error hai, jabke JP TRS table mein 2-4 = 2-way valve freeze / indoor ki temporary stop bataya gaya hai. Kaam karne se pehle apne model par confirm karein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: IPM zyada garam ho gaya

meaning.en: Second IPM overheat sub code, same lock-out as 2-4 on the outdoor inverter module.
meaning.ur: IPM overheat ka doosra sub code, outdoor inverter module par 2-4 jaisa hi lock-out.

causes.en: Heat sink or ventilation problem on the outdoor unit.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ke heat sink ya hawa ka masla hai.

causes.en: IPM mounting or gate drive fault.
causes.ur: IPM ki mounting ya gate drive kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check outdoor fan, fins and clearances, then retest.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan, fins aur khali jagah check karke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the IPM or outdoor power board if it repeats.
solutions.ur: Baar baar aaye to IPM ya outdoor power board badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Dehumidifying ki wajah se temporary stop

meaning.en: Status row, not a fault: the unit pauses during dehumidifying operation and resumes by itself.
meaning.ur: Yeh fault nahi, status hai: dehumidifying ke dauran unit ruk jati hai aur khud chalne lag jati hai.

causes.en: Normal cycle control while removing moisture.
causes.ur: Nami nikalte waqt normal cycle control chal raha hai.

causes.en: Low outdoor temperature during dry mode.
causes.ur: Dry mode mein outdoor temperature kam hona.

solutions.en: No repair needed, let the cycle finish.
solutions.ur: Koi repair nahi, cycle khatam hone dein.

solutions.en: If it stays stopped for hours, check filters and airflow.
solutions.ur: Ghanton tak ruke to filter aur hawa check karein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Heat exchanger thermistor open circuit ho gaya

meaning.en: Outdoor heat-exchanger thermistor circuit is open, usually a broken or unplugged sensor.
meaning.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger thermistor ki line open hai, aksar sensor toota ya plug khula hota hai.

causes.en: Thermistor connector is loose or off the socket.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector dheela ya socket se bahar hai.

causes.en: Sensor wire is cut or the thermistor is open inside.
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire toot gayi ya thermistor andar se open hai.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and check the sensor installation.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein aur sensor ki fitting check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor resistance, replace the assembly if open.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ka resistance naapein, open ho to assembly badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the sensor is good.
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi ho to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Outdoor temperature thermistor open circuit ho gaya

meaning.en: The outdoor ambient sensor circuit is open, so the unit stops reading outdoor temperature.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient sensor ki line open hai, is liye unit outdoor temperature ki sensing band ho jati hai.

causes.en: Sensor plug is loose or the wire is broken.
causes.ur: Sensor ka plug dheela hai ya wire toot gayi.

causes.en: Thermistor is open circuit internally.
causes.ur: Thermistor andar se open circuit hai.

solutions.en: Check and refit the sensor connector.
solutions.ur: Sensor connector check karke wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor ambient thermistor if open.
solutions.ur: Open nikle to outdoor ambient thermistor badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Suction thermistor open circuit ho gaya

meaning.en: Suction line thermistor circuit is open, so superheat control is lost.
meaning.ur: Suction line thermistor ki line open hai, superheat control khatam ho gaya.

causes.en: Sensor wire is cut or connector loose.
causes.ur: Sensor wire toot gayi ya connector dheela hai.

causes.en: Thermistor element open.
causes.ur: Thermistor element open hai.

solutions.en: Inspect the lead wire and plug, refit or replace.
solutions.ur: Wire aur plug dekh kar wapas lagayein ya badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the suction thermistor if the reading is infinite.
solutions.ur: Reading infinite ho to suction thermistor badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: 2-way valve thermistor open circuit ho gaya

meaning.en: The liquid-line 2-way valve thermistor is open, so valve and defrost control is disabled.
meaning.ur: Liquid line 2-way valve ka thermistor open hai, valve aur defrost control band ho gaya.

causes.en: Thermistor wire broken or connector open.
causes.ur: Thermistor wire toot gayi ya connector khula hai.

causes.en: Sensor not fitted in the correct position.
causes.ur: Sensor sahi jagah par fit nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check the sensor position and fit it back on the pipe.
solutions.ur: Sensor ki position check karke pipe par wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor if the circuit is open.
solutions.ur: Circuit open ho to thermistor badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Discharge thermistor open circuit ho gaya

meaning.en: Discharge temperature sensor is open, so high-discharge protection cannot work.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature sensor open hai, high discharge protection kaam nahi kar sakti.

causes.en: Sensor wire is burnt or cut at the outdoor unit.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit par sensor wire jal gayi ya toot gayi.

causes.en: Thermistor has gone open.
causes.ur: Thermistor open ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the connector and lead wire, replace the sensor.
solutions.ur: Connector aur wire check karke sensor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the sensor measures fine.
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi nikle to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Heat sink thermistor open circuit ho gaya

meaning.en: Inverter heat-sink thermistor is open, so module overheat protection is lost.
meaning.ur: Inverter heat sink ka thermistor open hai, module overheat protection khatam ho gayi.

causes.en: Heat sink sensor plug is loose or wire broken.
causes.ur: Heat sink sensor ka plug dheela ya wire toot gayi.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit the sensor plug and retest the unit.
solutions.ur: Sensor plug wapas lagakar unit dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the sensor tests open.
solutions.ur: Sensor open nikle to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: DC side over current ka error

meaning.en: DC side current went over limit in the outdoor inverter, the unit shuts down to protect the IPM.
meaning.ur: Outdoor inverter ki DC side current limit se nikal gayi, IPM ko bachane ke liye unit band ho gayi.

causes.en: IPM or compressor winding has shorted.
causes.ur: IPM ya compressor winding short ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Compressor lead wires (UVW) are wrongly connected.
causes.ur: Compressor ki UVW wires ghalat lag gayi hain.

causes.en: Valves left closed while the compressor ran.
causes.ur: Compressor chalte waqt stop valves band mile.

solutions.en: Open the 2-way and 3-way stop valves fully and check rotation.
solutions.ur: 2-way aur 3-way stop valves poori tarah kholein aur rotation check karein.

solutions.en: Check IPM short circuit and compressor terminals.
solutions.ur: IPM ka short circuit aur compressor ke terminal check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor IPM PWB if the current still trips.
solutions.ur: Current phir bhi trip ho to outdoor IPM PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: IPM pin level ghalat ho gaya

meaning.en: The IPM gate/pin level check failed at the outdoor module, so drive is locked out.
meaning.ur: Outdoor module par IPM gate/pin level check fail ho gaya, drive lock ho gaya.

causes.en: IPM is not seated correctly on the outdoor IPM PWB.
causes.ur: IPM outdoor IPW PWB par theek se nahi laga.

causes.en: IPM itself is damaged.
causes.ur: IPM khud kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power down and check that the IPM is mounted correctly.
solutions.ur: Power band karke IPM ki fitting check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor IPM PWB if seating is fine.
solutions.ur: Fitting sahi ho to outdoor IPM PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Compressor ghoomne ka error (DC fan drive)

meaning.en: Rotation detection failed while the module was driving, listed under main 6 in the ZU1 chart.
meaning.ur: Module ke chalte waqt rotation detection fail hua, ZU1 chart mein main 6 ke under hai.

causes.en: IPM not fixed to the heat sink or silicone grease missing.
causes.ur: IPM heat sink par nahi laga ya silicone grease nahi lagi.

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor or compressor wiring problem.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor ya compressor wiring mein masla hai.

solutions.en: Refit the IPM PWB with screws and fresh silicone.
solutions.ur: IPM PWB screws aur nayi silicone ke sath lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor fan motor and compressor lead wires.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor aur compressor ki wires check karein.

notes.en: Sub codes 6-2 and 6-3 exist only in the ZU1 service chart, not on the official Air App list.
notes.ur: Sub code 6-2 aur 6-3 sirf ZU1 service chart mein hain, official Air App list mein nahi.

source.title: Sharp SM-ZU1 / ZHU1 Service Manual (AY-XP12ZU1)

title.ur: Aur wajah: cycle, thermistor ya ganda coil

meaning.en: Catch-all sub code: cycle trouble, overheat judgement thermistor off, or dust-clogged filter and heat exchanger.
meaning.ur: Aam sub code: cycle ka masla, overheat judgement thermistor off, ya filter aur heat exchanger par dhund.

causes.en: Filter and heat exchanger are clogged with dust.
causes.ur: Filter aur heat exchanger dhund se block hain.

causes.en: Cycle problem such as weak gas or blocked pipe.
causes.ur: Cycle ka masla jaise gas kam ho ya pipe block ho.

causes.en: Overheat judgement thermistor is disconnected.
causes.ur: Overheat judgement thermistor khula hua hai.

solutions.en: Clean the filter and indoor/outdoor heat exchangers.
solutions.ur: Filter aur indoor/outdoor heat exchanger saaf karein.

solutions.en: Follow the service-manual flowchart for cycle diagnosis.
solutions.ur: Service manual ke flowchart se cycle diagnosis karein.

notes.en: ZU1 service chart only (6-3 'Other factors'); not present on the official Air App list.
notes.ur: Sirf ZU1 service chart mein hai (6-3 'Other factors'); official Air App list mein nahi.

source.title: Sharp SM-ZU1 / ZHU1 Service Manual (AY-XP12ZU1)

title.ur: AC side over current ka error

meaning.en: Alternating current drawn by the outdoor unit went over the allowed value.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ne allowed se zyada AC current khaya.

causes.en: Outdoor unit air outlet is blocked, motor is drawing high amps.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ki hawa block hai, motor zyada current le raha hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan is jammed or the fan motor is failing.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan atka hua hai ya fan motor kharab ho rahi hai.

causes.en: Power supply voltage is unstable.
causes.ur: Power supply voltage stable nahi hai.

solutions.en: Clear the outdoor air path and check fan rotation.
solutions.ur: Outdoor ka hawa ka raasta kholein aur fan ki rotation check karein.

solutions.en: Measure running amps against the nameplate value.
solutions.ur: Running ampere nameplate value se milayein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Band hone par bhi AC current error

meaning.en: Current is still detected on the AC input while the unit should be off.
meaning.ur: Unit band honi chahiye lekin AC input par current abhi bhi detect ho raha hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control board or relay is leaking current.
causes.ur: Outdoor control board ya relay current leak kar raha hai.

causes.en: IPM or bridge is damaged.
causes.ur: IPM ya bridge kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate power and check the IPM for continuity/short.
solutions.ur: Power alag karke IPM ka continuity/short check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor IPM PWB if shorted.
solutions.ur: Short nikle to outdoor IPM PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: AC current maximum se zyada

meaning.en: Peak AC current exceeded the maximum allowed by the outdoor control.
meaning.ur: Peak AC current outdoor control ki maximum limit se zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: Blocked airflow makes the motor pull maximum current.
causes.ur: Hawa block hone se motor maximum current le raha hai.

causes.en: Fan motor bearing is seized.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka bearing jam hai.

solutions.en: Clean the outdoor unit and free the fan blade.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit saaf karein aur fan blade azaad karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor if it does not spin freely.
solutions.ur: Fan motor freely na ghoomay to badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: AC current kam hone ka error

meaning.en: The AC current measured was lower than expected, pointing to a sensing or supply problem.
meaning.ur: Naapa hua AC current expected se kam aaya, sensing ya supply ka masla lagta hai.

causes.en: Open circuit in the current transformer secondary on the outdoor PWB.
causes.ur: Outdoor PWB par current transformer secondary mein open circuit hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant charge is abnormally low or flow is restricted.
causes.ur: Gas murawwat bohat kam hai ya flow block hai.

solutions.en: Check the secondary winding of the current transformer.
solutions.ur: Current transformer ki secondary winding check karein.

solutions.en: Correct the refrigerant charge and clear any pipe clogs.
solutions.ur: Gas charge theek karein aur pipe ki rukawat door karein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.en: Thermistor installation error or 4-way valve error
title.ur: Thermistor fitting error ya 4-way valve error

meaning.en: Cycle temperature control found a thermistor fitted in the wrong place or a 4-way valve that did not switch.
meaning.ur: Cycle temperature control ne ghalat jagah laga thermistor ya switch na hone wali 4-way valve pakri.

causes.en: Heat exchanger or 2-way valve thermistor is installed in the wrong position.
causes.ur: Heat exchanger ya 2-way valve thermistor ghalat jagah laga hai.

causes.en: 4-way valve or its coil is faulty.
causes.ur: 4-way valve ya uska coil kharab hai.

causes.en: Control PWB fault.
causes.ur: Control PWB kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit both thermistors in their correct positions.
solutions.ur: Dono thermistors sahi jagah par lagayein.

solutions.en: Check 4-way valve operation and coil, replace if needed.
solutions.ur: 4-way valve ka kaam aur coil check karein, zaroorat ho to badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Gas kam hona (refrigerant shortage)

meaning.en: System gas has run low; reported as a system fault and it can harm the compressor if ignored.
meaning.ur: System mein gas kam hai; yeh system fault hai aur ignore karne se compressor ko nuqsan ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak in the pipework or joints.
causes.ur: Piping ya flare joints se gas leak ho rahi hai.

causes.en: Unit was never fully charged after installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke baad unit poori tarah charge hi nahi hui.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting; leak test, vacuum and charge to spec.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein; leak test, vacuum aur spec hisab se gas charge karein.

solutions.en: Repair the leak point before recharging.
solutions.ur: Gas bharne se pehle leak wali jagah theek karein.

notes.en: Found on the JP TRS Sharp table as 9-1 (gas shortage); not on the official Air App list.
notes.ur: JP TRS Sharp table mein 9-1 (gas shortage) ke taur par mila; official Air App list mein nahi.

source.title: TRS Engineering — Sharp room air conditioner error codes

title.ur: Compressor torque control mein error

meaning.en: The inverter could not control compressor torque as demanded, so drive protection stopped the unit.
meaning.ur: Inverter compressor ka torque demand ke mutabik control nahi kar saka, drive protection ne unit rok di.

causes.en: Compressor winding or start-up problem.
causes.ur: Compressor winding ya start ka masla hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control board or power transistor fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control board ya power transistor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle once, then check compressor amps and windings.
solutions.ur: Ek baar power cycle karein, phir compressor ke ampere aur winding check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the compressor tests fine.
solutions.ur: Compressor sahi nikle to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.en: 4-way valve error or gas leak error
title.ur: 4-way valve error ya gas leak error

meaning.en: Reversing valve did not respond, or the unit judged a gas leak from the temperature pattern.
meaning.ur: Reversing valve ne respond nahi kiya, ya unit ne temperature pattern se gas leak ka andaza lagaya.

causes.en: 4-way valve or its coil is faulty.
causes.ur: 4-way valve ya uska coil kharab hai.

causes.en: Low refrigerant from a leak.
causes.ur: Leak ki wajah se gas kam hai.

causes.en: Thermistors fitted in the wrong position.
causes.ur: Thermistors ghalat jagah lage hain.

solutions.en: Check valve operation and coil, replace the 4-way valve if stuck.
solutions.ur: Valve aur coil check karein, stuck ho to 4-way valve badlein.

solutions.en: Leak test the system and recharge the specified amount.
solutions.ur: System ka leak test karein aur murawwat hisab se gas bharayin.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: 2-way aur 3-way valve close error

meaning.en: The stop valves did not open as commanded, so the unit will not run the cycle.
meaning.ur: Stop valves hukm ke mutabik nahi khule, is liye unit cycle nahi chala rahi.

causes.en: Service valves still closed after installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke baad service valves abhi bhi band hain.

causes.en: Expansion valve coil or valve is faulty.
causes.ur: Expansion valve ka coil ya valve kharab hai.

solutions.en: Fully open the 2-way and 3-way stop valves.
solutions.ur: 2-way aur 3-way stop valves poori tarah kholein.

solutions.en: Check expansion valve operation and replace the coil if needed.
solutions.ur: Expansion valve ka kaam check karein, zaroorat ho to coil badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Solenoid valve kharab ho gayi

meaning.en: A solenoid valve in the refrigerant circuit did not operate as commanded.
meaning.ur: Refrigerant circuit ka solenoid valve hukm ke mutabik nahi chala.

causes.en: Solenoid coil is open or burnt.
causes.ur: Solenoid coil open ya jal gaya hai.

causes.en: Wiring or control board output fault.
causes.ur: Wiring ya control board ka output kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check coil resistance and supply to the coil.
solutions.ur: Coil ka resistance aur coil ko supply check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the solenoid coil or the control board output.
solutions.ur: Solenoid coil ya control board output badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Outdoor EEPROM data ghalat

meaning.en: Stored settings on the outdoor board could not be read correctly.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board par save settings theek se padhi nahi ja sakin.

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed or lost its data.
causes.ur: EEPROM chip kharab ho gaya ya data kho gaya.

causes.en: Supply voltage glitch at power-up.
causes.ur: Power on waqt voltage ka jhatka laga.

solutions.en: Power cycle from the breaker for 10 seconds and retest.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 second power cycle karke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the code stays.
solutions.ur: Code rahe to outdoor control PWB badlein.

notes.en: TRS page wording for 10-0 is 'outdoor hardware error', official list says EEPROM data error.
notes.ur: TRS page par 10-0 ka lafz 'outdoor hardware error' hai, official list mein EEPROM data error hai.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Outdoor EEPROM data ghalat

meaning.en: Second EEPROM data check failed on the outdoor board.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board par EEPROM data ka doosra check fail ho gaya.

causes.en: EEPROM content corrupted.
causes.ur: EEPROM ka content kharab hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB kharab hai.

solutions.en: Restart once from the breaker.
solutions.ur: Breaker se ek baar restart karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if it repeats.
solutions.ur: Baar baar aaye to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Outdoor CPU RAM data ghalat

meaning.en: The outdoor CPU's RAM check failed, the control logic cannot run normally.
meaning.ur: Outdoor CPU ka RAM check fail ho gaya, control logic normal nahi chal sakta.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB is faulty.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB kharab hai.

causes.en: Noise or voltage disturbance on the board.
causes.ur: Board par noise ya voltage disturbance hai.

solutions.en: Turn the unit off at the breaker and isolate the mains supply for a few minutes, then switch it on again once — a single reset often clears a RAM check that failed right after a power cut or surge.
solutions.ur: Unit ko breaker se band karke main supply kuch minute ke liye alag rakhein, phir ek baar on karein — power cut ya surge ke baad RAM check fail hua ho to ek reset mein theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: With the power isolated, open the outdoor unit and check the control PWB: look for burnt tracks, dust or moisture and loose plug connectors; reseat the connectors, clean the board and restart to see if the code clears.
solutions.ur: Power band karke outdoor unit ka cover kholein aur control PWB check karein: jalay hue raaste, mitti ya nami aur dhile plugs dekhein; connectors dobara theek se lagayein, board saaf karke restart karein aur dekhein ke code chala gaya ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the RAM error returns after the reset and the board looks clean, the outdoor control PWB is faulty — fit the correct replacement board and retest; do not keep power-cycling the unit.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad RAM error wapas aaye aur board saaf dikhe to outdoor control PWB kharab hai — sahi replacement board lagayein aur dobara test karein; unit ko baar baar power-cycle na karein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Outdoor CPU kharab ho gaya

meaning.en: CPU-level fault reported by the outdoor board in the ZU1 chart.
meaning.ur: ZU1 chart mein outdoor board ne CPU level fault bataya hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB hardware failure.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB hardware fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Firmware/data corruption after a power surge.
causes.ur: Power surge ke baad firmware/data kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power cycle from the breaker and retry once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se power cycle karke ek baar try karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB.
solutions.ur: Outdoor control PWB badlein.

notes.en: ZU1 service chart only (10-3 CPU error); official Air App list stops at 10-2.
notes.ur: Sirf ZU1 service chart mein hai (10-3 CPU error); official Air App list 10-2 par khatam hoti hai.

source.title: Sharp SM-ZU1 / ZHU1 Service Manual (AY-XP12ZU1)

title.ur: Outdoor DC fan ghalat direction mein ghoom raha hai

meaning.en: The outdoor DC fan is not rotating as the board expects, the unit locks out to protect the compressor.
meaning.ur: Outdoor DC fan board ke mutabik nahi ghoom raha, compressor ko bachane ke liye unit lock ho jati hai.

causes.en: Fan motor is locked or the blades are jammed.
causes.ur: Fan motor lock hai ya blade atka hua hai.

causes.en: Fan drive circuit on the control PWB has failed.
causes.ur: Control PWB par fan drive circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Switch off power and try spinning the fan blade by hand.
solutions.ur: Power band karke fan blade haath se ghumakar dekhein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor, then the control PWB if needed.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badlein, zaroorat ho to control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.en: Outdoor DC fan driver IC error
title.ur: Outdoor DC fan driver IC kharab

meaning.en: The fan driver IC on the outdoor board reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board par fan driver IC ne fault bataya.

causes.en: Fan IPM terminal resistance values are uneven.
causes.ur: Fan IPM ke terminal resistance barabar nahi hain.

causes.en: Fan motor winding is open or shorted.
causes.ur: Fan motor winding open ya short hai.

solutions.en: Check fan IPM terminal resistance values.
solutions.ur: Fan IPM ke terminal resistance check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor, then the outdoor control PWB.
solutions.ur: Fan motor badlein, phir outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Outdoor DC fan lock ho gaya

meaning.en: The outdoor fan motor is physically locked and cannot turn.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor physically lock hai aur ghoom nahi raha.

causes.en: Bearing seized or blade obstruction.
causes.ur: Bearing jam hai ya blade mein rukawat hai.

causes.en: Motor winding failure.
causes.ur: Motor winding kharab hai.

solutions.en: Free the blade and check for debris in the motor.
solutions.ur: Blade ko azaad karein aur motor mein debris check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.en: DC fan negative rotation before compressor start
title.ur: Compressor start se pehle DC fan ulta ghooma

meaning.en: The outdoor fan turned backwards just before the compressor was energised.
meaning.ur: Compressor ko current dene se pehle outdoor fan ulta ghooma.

causes.en: Fan motor lead wires are swapped.
causes.ur: Fan motor ki wires ulta lag gayi hain.

causes.en: Fan drive circuit fault on the outdoor PWB.
causes.ur: Outdoor PWB par fan drive circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Temporarily this is handled by DC fan circuit protection.
solutions.ur: Filhal is par DC fan circuit protection ka ilaj hai.

solutions.en: Check fan lead wire order and the outdoor PWB.
solutions.ur: Fan ki wire ka order aur outdoor PWB check karein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.en: Inverter current detection error for DC fan
title.ur: DC fan ke liye inverter current detection error

meaning.en: The board could not read the fan current correctly, so it stopped the drive.
meaning.ur: Board fan ka current theek se padh nahi saka, is liye drive band kar di.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB current sensing fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB ka current sensing kharab hai.

causes.en: Fan motor drawing abnormal current.
causes.ur: Fan motor abnormal current le raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the fan motor and its connector.
solutions.ur: Fan motor aur uska connector check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB.
solutions.ur: Outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.en: Outdoor DC fan connector open error
title.ur: Outdoor DC fan ka connector khula hua hai

meaning.en: The outdoor fan motor connector is not seated or its wire is open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor ka connector laga nahi ya wire khuli hai.

causes.en: CN3 connector of the fan motor is loose.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka CN3 connector dheela hai.

causes.en: Wire pulled out or broken at the plug.
causes.ur: Wire plug se nikal gayi ya toot gayi.

solutions.en: Refit the fan connector securely and retest.
solutions.ur: Fan connector mazbooti se lagakar dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the connector is fine.
solutions.ur: Connector sahi ho to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.en: Thermal fuse error in terminal board
title.ur: Terminal board ka thermal fuse error

meaning.en: The power-supply thermal fuse in the terminal block has opened, cutting supply to the unit.
meaning.ur: Terminal block mein power supply ka thermal fuse open ho gaya, unit ko current kat gaya.

causes.en: Overheating at the terminal block from a loose connection.
causes.ur: Terminal block ka dheela connection se garmi.

causes.en: Sustained overcurrent or a shorted component.
causes.ur: Lambe waqt se overcurrent ya koi shorted part.

solutions.en: Do not bypass the fuse; find why it blew before replacing.
solutions.ur: Fuse ko bypass na karein; badalne se pehle jalne ki wajah check karein.

solutions.en: Check terminals for tightness and signs of burning, replace the fuse/terminal assembly.
solutions.ur: Terminal ki tightness aur jalne ke nishan dekhein, fuse/terminal assembly badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Compressor start na hone ka error

meaning.en: The compressor failed to start when the inverter drove it.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne compressor ko chalaya lekin compressor start nahi hua.

causes.en: Compressor is faulty or its winding is shorted.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab hai ya uski winding short hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control board or power transistor fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control board ya power transistor kharab hai.

causes.en: Compressor terminals are loose or wrongly marked.
causes.ur: Compressor ke terminal dheele ya ghalat mark hue hain.

solutions.en: Check compressor continuity, insulation and terminal tightness.
solutions.ur: Compressor ki continuity, insulation aur terminal ki tightness check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the compressor or the outdoor control PWB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabik compressor ya outdoor control PWB badlein.

notes.en: ZU1 chart words 13-0 as 'compressor winding short circuit' while official list and TRS say startup error; treat as a startup/lock fault and verify on the model.
notes.ur: ZU1 chart mein 13-0 'compressor winding short circuit' likha hai, official list aur TRS mein yeh startup error hai; ise startup/lock fault samajhein aur model par confirm karein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Compressor ghoomne ka error (120 degree energising)

meaning.en: The compressor turned abnormally while being driven at 120 degree steps.
meaning.ur: Compressor 120 degree steps par chalte waqt ghoomne mein ghalat raha.

causes.en: Power transistor or outdoor board fault.
causes.ur: Power transistor ya outdoor board kharab hai.

causes.en: Compressor winding or terminal issue.
causes.ur: Compressor winding ya terminal ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Check the power transistor and outdoor control PWB.
solutions.ur: Power transistor aur outdoor control PWB check karein.

solutions.en: Verify compressor windings and replace if shorted.
solutions.ur: Compressor windings check karein, short ho to badlein.

notes.en: ZU1 chart words 13-1 as 'compressor winding open etc'; official wording kept as the title.
notes.ur: ZU1 chart mein 13-1 'compressor winding open etc' likha hai; title mein official lafz rakha gaya hai.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Compressor ghoomne ka error (180 degree energising)

meaning.en: The compressor rotor position was wrong while being driven at 180 degree steps.
meaning.ur: Compressor ko 180 degree steps par chalate waqt rotor ki position ghalat thi.

causes.en: Compressor is locked (seized).
causes.ur: Compressor lock (jam) ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Inverter power stage fault.
causes.ur: Inverter power stage kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the compressor can be turned by hand with power off.
solutions.ur: Power band karke compressor haath se ghumta hai ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: Replace the compressor if seized, or the outdoor PWB if not.
solutions.ur: Jam ho to compressor badlein, warna outdoor PWB badlein.

notes.en: ZU1 chart words 13-2 as 'compressor lock'; official wording kept.
notes.ur: ZU1 chart mein 13-2 'compressor lock' likha hai; official lafz rakha gaya hai.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Inverter current detect nahi ho raha

meaning.en: Inverter current sensing was out of range; in the ZU1 chart this sub code is an over-current pause that protects the outdoor PWB.
meaning.ur: Inverter ki current sensing range se bahar thi; ZU1 chart mein yeh sub code outdoor PWB ko bachane wala over-current pause hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB or power transistor fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB ya power transistor kharab hai.

causes.en: Compressor drawing abnormal current.
causes.ur: Compressor abnormal current le raha hai.

solutions.en: Check outdoor board and power transistor stage.
solutions.ur: Outdoor board aur power transistor stage check karein.

solutions.en: Measure compressor amps before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Parts badalne se pehle compressor ke ampere naapein.

notes.en: ZU1 chart calls 13-3 'over current pause' (indoor keeps running, outdoor pauses).
notes.ur: ZU1 chart mein 13-3 'over current pause' hai (indoor chalta rehta hai, outdoor ruk jata hai).

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: PAM mein over voltage ka error

meaning.en: The PAM (power factor) circuit saw an over-voltage condition on the DC bus.
meaning.ur: PAM (power factor) circuit ne DC bus par over-voltage dekhi.

causes.en: Mains voltage is swinging outside range.
causes.ur: Mains voltage range se bahar ja raha hai.

causes.en: Outdoor PWB or PFC stage fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor PWB ya PFC stage kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC supply for fluctuation.
solutions.ur: AC supply ki fluctuation check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor board assembly if supply is steady.
solutions.ur: Supply stable ho to outdoor board assembly badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: PAM clock ghalat chal raha

meaning.en: The PAM timing clock signal was missing or wrong on the outdoor board.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board par PAM timing clock signal nahi aya ya ghalat thi.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB kharab hai.

causes.en: Oscillator or drive circuit failure.
causes.ur: Oscillator ya drive circuit fail ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power cycle once and check the clock input on the PWB.
solutions.ur: Ek baar power cycle karein aur PWB par clock input check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB.
solutions.ur: Outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: PAM mein under voltage ka error

meaning.en: DC bus voltage dropped too low, or the supply voltage was abnormal during run.
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage bohat neeche chala gaya, ya chalne ke dauran supply voltage ghalat thi.

causes.en: AC supply voltage is low or unstable.
causes.ur: AC supply voltage kam ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Outdoor PWB power stage problem.
causes.ur: Outdoor PWB ki power stage mein masla hai.

solutions.en: Check supply voltage at the outdoor terminal.
solutions.ur: Outdoor terminal par supply voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor board assembly if supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Supply normal ho to outdoor board assembly badlein.

notes.en: ZU1 words the same sub code as 'abnormal power supply voltage / DC low voltage'.
notes.ur: ZU1 mein isi sub code ko 'abnormal power supply voltage / DC low voltage' likha hai.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: PFC module kharab ho gaya

meaning.en: The power factor correction module reported a fault, so the outdoor unit stops.
meaning.ur: Power factor correction module ne fault bataya, outdoor unit band ho jati hai.

causes.en: PFC module or IGBT failure.
causes.ur: PFC module ya IGBT fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate power and check the PFC stage for shorts.
solutions.ur: Power alag karke PFC stage ka short check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB / PFC module.
solutions.ur: Outdoor control PWB ya PFC module ko badal dein

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Serial line khuli ho gayi (indoor-outdoor)

meaning.en: Serial communication line between indoor and outdoor is open; the outdoor unit will not run.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan serial communication line khuli hai, outdoor unit nahi chalti.

causes.en: Inter-unit wiring is loose, cut or wrongly connected.
causes.ur: Inter-unit wire dheeli, kati ya ghalat lag gayi hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fuse or outdoor control PWB is dead.
causes.ur: Outdoor fuse ya outdoor control PWB dead hai.

causes.en: 15V/12V/5V supplies missing on the outdoor PWB.
causes.ur: Outdoor PWB par 15V/12V/5V supply nahi aa rahi.

solutions.en: Check the wires between the units and the supply at the terminals.
solutions.ur: Units ke darmiyan wire aur terminal par supply check karein.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor fuse and PWB voltages (15V, 12V, 5V).
solutions.ur: Outdoor fuse aur PWB ki voltages (15V, 12V, 5V) check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if power is present but no signal.
solutions.ur: Power maujood ho lekin signal na ho to outdoor control PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Serial line khuli ho gayi (variant)

meaning.en: Second serial open sub code: outdoor LED lit with serial open and the outdoor unit not powering up.
meaning.ur: Serial open ka doosra sub code: outdoor LED jali rehti hai, serial open hai aur outdoor unit power nahi leti.

causes.en: Inter-unit wire disconnected or broken.
causes.ur: Inter-unit wire khuli ya toot gayi hai.

causes.en: Outdoor control PWB fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor control PWB kharab hai.

solutions.en: Re-check and refit the inter-unit wiring.
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring dobara check karke lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor control PWB if the wiring is sound.
solutions.ur: Wiring sahi ho to outdoor control PWB badlein.

notes.en: Listed only on the JP TRS Sharp table (17-1); not on the official Air App list.
notes.ur: Sirf JP TRS Sharp table mein hai (17-1); official Air App list mein nahi.

source.title: TRS Engineering — Sharp room air conditioner error codes

title.ur: Serial line short ho gayi (indoor-outdoor)

meaning.en: The serial line between indoor and outdoor is shorted, so data cannot pass.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ki serial line short hai, data pass nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Inter-unit wires touching or moisture in the terminal.
causes.ur: Inter-unit wires ek dusre se lag rahi hain ya terminal mein nami hai.

causes.en: Wrong inter-unit connection during installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke waqt inter-unit connection ghalat hua.

solutions.en: Correct the wiring between the units and insulate properly.
solutions.ur: Units ki wiring theek karein aur theek se insulate karein.

solutions.en: Check the terminal board for water or carbon tracks.
solutions.ur: Terminal board par paani ya carbon nishan dekhein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Serial wiring ghalat

meaning.en: Wiring between indoor and outdoor is crossed; the ZU1 manual shows this code for specific inter-unit wiring mistakes.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ki wiring aapas mein ulat gayi hai; ZU1 manual isi wiring ghalat-fahmi par yeh code dikhata hai.

causes.en: L1/L2 lines swapped between indoor and outdoor.
causes.ur: L1/L2 lines indoor aur outdoor mein ulta lag gayi.

causes.en: Incorrect terminal connections at site.
causes.ur: Site par terminal connections ghalat hain.

solutions.en: Power off and correct the inter-unit wiring per the diagram.
solutions.ur: Power band karke inter-unit wiring diagram ke mutabik theek karein.

solutions.en: Recheck that L and N correspond on both units.
solutions.ur: Dono units par L aur N ek dusre ke mutabik hain, yeh dobara check karein.

notes.en: Same code also appears in the SM-ZU1/ZHU1 service manual, which shows the inter-unit wiring check (L1/L2) for this fault; corroborated by Snowflake Aircon's Sharp guide.
notes.ur: Yeh code SM-ZU1/ZHU1 service manual mein bhi hai jismein inter-unit wiring (L1/L2) check dikhaya gaya hai; Snowflake Aircon ki Sharp guide se bhi tasdeeq.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: High speed serial communication ka error

meaning.en: High-speed serial data between the boards was corrupted although the units can still run.
meaning.ur: Boards ke darmiyan high-speed serial data kharab tha, halanki units chal sakti hain.

causes.en: Serial circuit on the indoor or outdoor board is faulty.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor board ka serial circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Noise from wiring routing near power cables.
causes.ur: Power cable ke qareeb wiring se noise aa raha hai.

solutions.en: If the unit runs, no action may be needed; monitor it.
solutions.ur: Unit chal rahi ho to kuch nahi karna, nazar rakhein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor or outdoor PWB if faults repeat.
solutions.ur: Fault dohraye to indoor ya outdoor PWB badlein.

source.title: Sharp Air App — Air-Conditioner Error Code List

title.ur: Indoor unit ka fan kharab hai

meaning.en: The indoor fan is not running correctly, so the unit stops to avoid coil freeze or overheating.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan theek se nahi chal raha, is liye unit coil freeze ya overheat se bachane ke liye rok deti hai.

causes.en: Cross-flow fan blade is blocked or the motor is locked.
causes.ur: Cross-flow fan blade block hai ya motor lock hai.

causes.en: Indoor fan motor lead wire is open or connector loose.
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor ki wire khuli hai ya connector dheela hai.

solutions.en: Check the fan blade for free rotation and refit the motor connector.
solutions.ur: Fan blade ki free rotation check karein aur motor connector wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor fan motor, then the indoor control PWB.
solutions.ur: Indoor fan motor badlein, phir indoor control PWB badlein.

causes.en: Fan capacitor or motor is weakening.
causes.ur: Fan capacitor ya motor kamzor ho raha hai.

causes.ur: Blade housing se ragad kha raha hai.

solutions.en: Free the blade and clean the indoor unit.
solutions.ur: Blade azaad karein aur indoor unit saaf karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor fan motor if speed stays low.
solutions.ur: Speed kam rahe to indoor fan motor badlein.

solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor PWB par fan driver check karein.

meaning.en: Settings stored on the indoor control board could not be read at power-up.

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed or data was corrupted by a power dip.

causes.ur: Indoor control PWB kharab hai.

title.en: External EEPROM initial data reading error
title.ur: External EEPROM initial data read nahi ho raha

meaning.en: The external EEPROM's starting data could not be read by the control.
meaning.ur: Control external EEPROM ka starting data padh nahi saka.

causes.en: EEPROM device or its soldering is faulty.
causes.ur: EEPROM chip ya uski soldering kharab hai.

causes.en: Indoor/outdoor control PWB problem.
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor control PWB mein masla hai.

solutions.en: Switch off at the breaker and isolate the supply, then restart once from the breaker — a cold start lets the control try to read the EEPROM starting data again.
solutions.ur: Breaker se unit band karke supply alag karein, phir breaker se ek baar restart karein - thanda start karne par control EEPROM ka starting data dobara read karne ki koshish karta hai.

solutions.en: With power isolated, inspect the small EEPROM on the control PWB: check that it sits firmly in its socket and look for dry, cracked or cold solder joints around it; re-solder if needed, then restart and watch whether the reading error returns.
solutions.ur: Power band karke control PWB par chhota EEPROM dekhein: chip socket mein theek se baitha ho aur uske aas paas ki soldering mein darar ya kharabi na ho; zaroorat ho to soldering dobara karke restart karein aur reading error wapas aaya ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: If the error stays, the EEPROM data or the control PWB itself is faulty — replace the EEPROM, or the whole indoor/outdoor control PWB, and retest the unit.
solutions.ur: Error jaari rahe to EEPROM ka data ya control PWB hi kharab hai — EEPROM ya pura indoor/outdoor control PWB badal kar unit ko dobara test karein.

title.ur: Sub microcomputer ka error (variant 6)

meaning.en: Same sub-microcontroller family fault, sub code 6.
meaning.ur: Wahi sub microcontroller family ki fault hai, sub code 6

causes.en: Control PWB hardware fault.
causes.ur: Control PWB hardware kharab hai.

causes.en: Communication disturbance on the board.
causes.ur: Board par communication disturbance hai.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker and isolate the supply for a few minutes, then switch on and retest — this often clears a one-off communication disturbance on the board.
solutions.ur: Breaker se power band karke supply kuch minute alag rakhein, phir on karke dobara test karein — board par ek dafa ka communication disturbance aksar chala jata hai.

solutions.en: With power isolated, open the outdoor unit and check the control PWB: look for loose plugs, burnt marks or dust bridging the communication lines, reseat the connectors, clean the board and restart to see if the blink code clears.
solutions.ur: Power band karke outdoor unit kholein aur control PWB check karein: dhile plugs, jalay hue nishan ya communication lines par mitti dekhein, connectors dobara lagayein, board saaf karke restart karein aur dekhein ke blink code chala gaya ya nahi.

solutions.en: If sub code 6 returns immediately, the control PWB hardware is faulty — fit the correct replacement board for the unit and retest; do not keep power-cycling.
solutions.ur: Sub code 6 foran wapas aaye to control PWB hardware kharab hai — unit ke liye sahi replacement board lagayein aur dobara test karein; unit ko baar baar power-cycle na karein.

solutions.ur: Sub code 7 foran wapas aaye to control PWB hardware kharab hai — unit ke liye sahi replacement board lagayein aur dobara test karein; unit ko baar baar power-cycle na karein.
